item: row 264: a request that meets a store switch is refused with its words, not a 500
refs: PR #2226; row 264; row 271; follows row 256 (R702 part 2)
key_paths: src/api/main.py; src/jobs/background.py; src/versioned/store.py; src/database/file_identity.py; src/database/rebuild.py; tests/test_lane_swap_refusal_row264.py
summary: LaneSwapping (an open that waited past SWAP_WAIT_S during a store's switch) now answers a route with 409 and the fixed SWAPPING_WORDS, no traceback; a background job whose failure is or was raised from it records exactly those words and logs one line (from None opts out); callers that catch it themselves are unchanged. Release line: If a page or background task tries to read a separate store while it is being switched for its rebuilt copy, it now says so and asks you to try again, instead of reporting an internal error. Row 271 (OPEN on watch: the CI cause was not reproduced locally): the switch's count is fail closed (an entry leaves only when its pool record is collected; a detached connection counts until closed) and counts per FILE, by the (device, inode) the open reached, so a connection on another folder's copy of a lane no longer counts, and an identity that cannot be read counts everywhere; a refused hold logs the threads that held it. Release line: A store rebuild is no longer refused because of a connection to a different file, or one that was already gone.
